## The Golden Record: Earth’s Material and Instructions for Playing It

Each Voyager spacecraft carried a gold-plated record that combined selected material from Earth with guidance for playing it. The collection included 115 analog images, natural sounds, music from different cultures and eras, and spoken greetings in 55 languages.

Each record was accompanied by a cartridge and needle, along with symbolic instructions explaining the spacecraft’s origin and how to play the audio. The Golden Record was both a collection of material from Earth and an object supplied with directions for hearing it.
